# dotnet-github-packages-release

Publishes .NET NuGet packages to a GitHub Packages organisation feed, lets the organisation's other repositories restore them, and cuts versioned releases with a changelog gate, a tag, GitHub release notes and cross-platform binaries. Use when writing a nuget.config for https://nuget.pkg.github.com, packing and pushing with GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions, choosing between MinVer and an explicit version, giving a consumer repository read access to private packages, running gh release create, or debugging a failed release workflow. Do NOT use for C# language or framework advice such as nullable reference types, async code or ASP.NET design (use dotnet-guru), or for pushing to nuget.org with an API key.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r dotnet-github-packages-release ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r dotnet-github-packages-release .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.
